name: tests-half-tortoise-orm-portable-per-statement-d498
instr:
Add execution timeouts for SQLite and selected ORM operations. Preserve existing behaviour.

ExecutionOptions is immutable and reusable. Default/from_timeout() exposes timeout=None; positive finite timeout values retain their requested value. from_timeout rejects zero, negative, infinite, NaN and boolean values with TypeError or ValueError.

SqliteClient.execute_query accepts execution_options. Long-running queries raise QueryExecutionTimeout, an OperationalError with the requested timeout and a nonempty string operation. After timeout the same client supports later reads and writes. Omitted or default options preserve successful ordinary query results.

Controlled SELECT returns (row_count, rows) with existing row values/order; controlled UPDATE returns affected count and empty rows. execute_query_dict retains dictionary values, including embedded NUL characters. Earlier syntax errors remain OperationalError and script integrity errors remain IntegrityError, rather than QueryExecutionTimeout. An expired execute_insert raises QueryExecutionTimeout without inserting.

QuerySet.with_execution_options applies expired controls to ordinary queries, values, update, delete, bulk_create, bulk_update and prefetch_related. These expired operations preserve existing parent/child rows and values. Model.save(execution_options=...) carries an expired control to insertion without creating a row. Reusing an options instance across successful queries does not change its timeout.
